<thought>From the 13C NMR data, only one carbon resonance appears in the typical methyl region (≈10‑30 ppm), at 26.41 ppm. The other low-field signals (36‑38 ppm) correspond to methylene or tertiary carbons, not methyls. Therefore the molecule contains a single methyl group.</thought>
<final_answer>1</final_answer>
